# Chat support widget

*Client industry: education | Completed: 2022-11-16 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p11*

## The problem
The client was an online course seller answering questions by email.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using React, live updates pushed to the browser, a JavaScript backend, a relational database with proper migrations. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project answered 80% of pre-sale questions live.
